title: The CyberUnicorn console sends its device log to support when something goes wrong

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: 'I cannot use control C and the copy button didnt' work', then chose 'Yes, send it automatically' on 'Should the console send its device log to me when errors happen?'.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE: the device log lived only in the browser tab, so diagnosing a failed placard write needed the owner to copy text out of the console mid-demo. Now every problem the console shows (and every Copy log press) calls reportConsoleLog (lib/devices/log-actions.ts): consoleStaffGate, at most 60 lines of 400 chars, signed /c/ links and ?s= signatures cut server side, written to the runtime log as one `[cu5k-log]` line. Nothing is stored in the database. 2026-10-21 follow-up: a Network is $149 plus $59 for each chapter and starts with three chapters ($326, ADR-1815); the motion figures no longer say the three are 'included' as if free, so every graphic reads '3 to start, from $326'. Money math unchanged. 2026-10-21 second pass (design handoff revision): the calculator sits directly under the plan cards and is step-locked (one wheel notch, swipe, arrow key or Back / Next press is one step; first step scrolls up and last scrolls down so the page is never a trap; Skip the walk-through jumps past it), with the action line over each tier, the breathing orbit motion, the larger Network orb and a three-column plan picker. Not taken from the design: 'Free with Crew' for the Free Space, because nothing in the product requires Crew to open a free Space.

verify.note: Fails when the action loses its staff gate or its redaction, stops writing [cu5k-log], or the console stops calling it on a problem or a Copy log press.
